Rows.Title: Time-series momentum in cryptocurrency markets
Rows.Snippet: We backtest a trend-following moving average rule on bitcoin and the largest cryptocurrencies with transaction costs and report out-of-sample Sharpe ratios above one, robust across subperiods and to realistic trading frictions.

Rows.Title: Funding rates and the cross-section of perpetual futures returns
Rows.Snippet: Perpetual futures funding rates predict returns. A carry strategy long low-funding and short high-funding contracts earns excess returns after costs; we document the effect out-of-sample.

Rows.Title: Volatility-managed portfolios
Rows.Snippet: Scaling exposure by inverse realised volatility raises Sharpe ratios across factors; momentum crashes cluster in high-volatility states.

Rows.Title: Existence and uniqueness of equilibria in a mean-field game
Rows.Snippet: We prove a theorem establishing existence and uniqueness of solutions to a class of stochastic differential equations arising in a mean-field game of optimal execution.
